description: Check whether a Kulhad page name is free. A page name is the last part of the address, as in kulhad.co/priya. Use this before suggesting a name to somebody setting up a page.

username.description: The page name to check, without the address around it. For example: priya

name: check_username_available

reason.description: Why it cannot be used, when it cannot.

suggestions.description: Nearby names that are free, when the first is not.

url.description: The address this name would give, when it is free.

title: Check a page name
